name: The Goddess Provides

angles.text: As a night elf, you inherit Elune’s blessings: moonlight to reveal hidden paths and shadows to conceal your presence.
After the battle at Mount Hyjal, the night elves ended their long isolation and joined the Alliance. You share your people’s lunar powers in service of mutual defense.
As a kaldorei priest, you devote yourself to Mother Moon and channel Elune’s grace as guiding radiance and divine protection.

faq.answer: Young night elves learn to recognize and demonstrate Elune’s blessings in a rite beneath Teldrassil’s boughs.
The goddess is Elune, whom the kaldorei call Mother Moon. She is central to night elf culture and spiritual life, and they believe she grants her children protection, clarity, and stealth.
faq.q: Who is the goddess referenced in this quest?

faq.answer: Elune grants radiance that guides a warrior’s strikes and the power to blend into surrounding shadows.
faq.q: What gifts does Elune provide to the kaldorei?

aliases: why did the long vigil end
faq.answer: The Long Vigil was the thousands of years when the night elves guarded Kalimdor in isolation. It ended after they defended Mount Hyjal against the Burning Legion, and the kaldorei then opened their borders.

aliases: why did night elves join alliance
faq.answer: After defending Mount Hyjal, the night elves ended their long isolation and chose to forge ties with mortal races across the sea. They joined the Grand Alliance for mutual survival and camaraderie.
faq.q: Why have the night elves joined the Alliance?

faq.answer: Teldrassil is a Great Tree off Kalimdor’s northern coast. After the Third War, its sheltered boughs became the night elves’ new home and sanctuary.
faq.q: Where does this instruction take place?

sections.body:
For millennia after the Sundering, the kaldorei kept apart from other peoples. During the Long Vigil, they watched over Kalimdor and guarded the sacred peaks of Mount Hyjal. The Third War brought devastation, and the defense of the World Tree ended their ancient seclusion.

Now the night elves dwell beneath Teldrassil’s boughs and face an unfamiliar world. They reach across the ocean to make allies and take their place among Azeroth’s peoples.
sections.title: A Vigil Concluded

sections.body:
Elune, the Mother Moon, remains at the heart of kaldorei faith, though the night elves now dwell in a new home and form new ties. From their earliest days, they learn to call on her gifts. Her radiance guides their strikes and clarifies their purpose. Her shadow hides them from enemy sight.

These inherited blessings bind the kaldorei to their goddess and prepare them for dangers beyond the Great Tree.
sections.title: Blessings of Mother Moon

summary: Beneath Teldrassil, young night elves begin a rite that teaches them to know Elune’s gifts. After the Long Vigil, they seek guidance in her radiance and shelter in her shadow.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Goddess Provides
